title: config S3 validation uses .unwrap() after is_none() guard
description: In config.rs S3 backend validation, the code checks if field.is_none() then on the next line calls field.unwrap(). This is the clippy::option_if_let_chain pattern; use if let Some(v) = field instead. As written, a refactor that reorders the None check will produce a panic. The is_none check and unwrap are not in the same expression scope, so the compiler cannot help.
